editorial:
Imagine a world where a man makes a living by being the meanest person in the room. You meet a loan shark who spends his days bullying people and taking their money through fear and violence. He has no love in his life and doesn't want any. But everything changes when a strange woman shows up and says she is the mother he never knew. She is kind and gentle, and she tries to soften his hard heart. The vibe is very heavy and sad, making you feel the weight of his lonely life and the weird tension between these two strangers.

What really hits hard is the acting; you can see the pain on the man's face as he starts to care for her. The story has some big twists that will leave you shocked, though the slow speed might feel a bit long for some. If you like movies that make you think about forgiveness and pain, you need to see this. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you really love the cinematography, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out the woman is not actually his mother. She is part of a plan to get revenge on him for the people he hurt. After she pushes him to be a better person, she kills herself to make him feel the worst pain possible. In the end, he is broken and loses everything. He ends up killing the woman's real son before he is finally caught, showing that the cycle of violence never really stops.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves deep stories about revenge and family.
